highlights.reason_zh: 安全默认值、Python 版本与 streaming contract 同时变化，生产 serving 需要有计划地升级。
highlights.reason_en: Security defaults, Python support and streaming contracts change together, requiring a planned production upgrade.

highlights.reason_zh: MCP 的默认和凭据边界更安全，但会打断依赖 stdio 的现有部署。
highlights.reason_en: Safer MCP defaults and credential boundaries can break deployments that rely on stdio.

highlights.reason_zh: 专用 memory writer 可能降低长时 agent 的成本，但作者子样本需要用真实日志复测。
highlights.reason_en: A specialist memory writer may cut long-running agent cost, but the author-run subsample needs real-log reproduction.

highlights.reason_zh: MIT 权重和部署配方已公开；1M 上下文与 coding 成绩仍缺可复现证据。
highlights.reason_en: MIT weights and deployment recipes are public; 1M context and coding results remain unverified.

highlights.reason_zh: 一次前向计算的决策模型适合实测路由成本；新版不能直接继承旧版权威排名。
highlights.reason_en: A one-pass decision model is practical for routing-cost tests, but the new checkpoint cannot inherit the older rank.

coverage_zh: 36/36 个固定入口抓取并读完；主动检索覆盖中文一手材料、小团队、开放权重、研究、基础设施与政策，并完成 7 日到期补漏。Grok Voice 只有日期精度；模型 benchmark 多为作者自报，Step 5 Preview 与 FLUX 3 Klein 因发布时间或许可边界未定而暂缓；召回自检另补录 Indra OCR，并把 Sphinx 0.1 明确标为 IGNORE。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and reviewed; active discovery covered Chinese primary material, small teams, open weights, research, infrastructure and policy, and the seven-day gap review was completed. Grok Voice has date-only timing; most model benchmarks are author-reported, while Step 5 Preview and FLUX 3 Klein were deferred over publication-time or license boundaries; recall audit also recovered Indra OCR and explicitly marked Sphinx 0.1 IGNORE.
